run_forward_dynamics_learning: run the KUKA iiwa forward dynamics learning example to optimize learnable robot model parameters
create_learnable_robot_model: create a DifferentiableRobotModel from a URDF file and make link mass, COM, and inertia parameters learnable
generate_forward_dynamics_data: generate sine motion forward dynamics training data using a ground truth KUKA iiwa robot model
compute_forward_dynamics: compute forward dynamics predictions given joint positions, velocities, and applied torques with gravity and damping
review_NMSELoss: review the NMSELoss class that computes normalized mean squared error weighted by data variance
